$comment: Everything about the event lives in this file. The page, the RSVP rules and the assistant all read it. Every person, place and code here is fictional.
scheduleLede: Three days by the harbor. Come to as much as you can.
demoNote: Demo wedding: the couple, guests and invitation codes are made up. Try invitation MP-4821 with the last name Pell. RSVPs stay in this page until you refresh it, and nothing is sent anywhere.

events.name: Rehearsal dinner
events.place: The Chart Room, upstairs at Sea Wall Hall
events.details: For the wedding party and family. Your invitation says if you are invited.
events.inviteOnlyReason: The rehearsal dinner is for the wedding party and family

events.name: Welcome drinks
events.place: The porch at Sea Wall Hall
events.details: Drop in any time. Drinks and small bites. Casual clothes.

events.name: Ceremony
events.details: Outdoors on the grass. Please arrive by 3:40 pm. If it rains, the ceremony moves inside Sea Wall Hall at the same time.

events.name: Reception
events.details: Cocktails on the porch, then dinner and dancing in the hall.

events.name: Farewell brunch
events.place: The porch at Sea Wall Hall
events.details: Come and go. Coffee, pastries and goodbyes.

shuttle.stop: Marrow Point town square, by the clock
shuttle.note: The shuttle has a wheelchair lift. Lighthouse Lawn to Sea Wall Hall is a 5-minute walk along a paved path, or ride the shuttle's loop at 16:35.

meals.name: Kids' plate: pasta with butter and parmesan

faq.question: What should I wear?
faq.answer: Garden formal: summer suits, dresses or jumpsuits. The ceremony is on grass, so block heels or flats are kinder than stilettos. Bring a layer: it gets cool by the water after sunset.

faq.question: Can I bring my kids?
faq.answer: We love your kids! Children named on your invitation are very welcome. There is a kids' plate on the menu.

faq.question: Can I bring a guest?
faq.answer: Your invitation lists everyone invited. If it says you may bring a guest, add their name when you RSVP.

faq.question: When do I need to RSVP?
faq.answer: By May 1, 2027, on this page. You can change your answer here until then.

faq.question: Where do I park?
faq.answer: Free parking at the Sea Wall Hall lot (about 40 spaces) and on Harbor Street. Easier still: park once near the town square and take the shuttle.

faq.question: Is the venue accessible?
faq.answer: Sea Wall Hall is step-free with an accessible restroom. Lighthouse Lawn has a paved path to a level seating area. The shuttle has a wheelchair lift. Tell us anything you need in the RSVP notes.

faq.question: What if it rains?
faq.answer: The ceremony moves inside Sea Wall Hall at the same time. We will post a note here by 10 am on the day.

faq.question: Can I take photos?
faq.answer: We are having an unplugged ceremony: please keep phones away for those 30 minutes. Snap away at the reception.

faq.question: Do you have a registry?
faq.answer: Your company is the gift. If you would like to give something, there is a card box at the reception for contributions to our honeymoon.

faq.question: How do I get to Marrow Point?
faq.answer: The nearest airport is Port Hollis (PHL-X, about 50 minutes by car). From the north, take Coast Road 9 and follow the signs for the harbor. There is no train.

partners.name: Tidewhistle Guesthouse
partners.note: A small guesthouse on the harbor, a 6-minute walk from Sea Wall Hall. We have not reserved a room block: book directly on their site.

partners.name: Marrow Point Harbor Tours
partners.note: Boat trips and harbor walks, a nice way to spend Friday or Sunday morning. Book directly on their site.

partners.name: Harborline Cabs
partners.note: The local cab company: rides around town and to and from Port Hollis airport. Book directly with them.
